rules.match: exact, case-sensitive raw value as it appears in the source; no trimming, no merging of variants
rules.never_infer: A label is never inferred from IPs, hosts, users or how an event looks (OD-21, FR-41).
rules.pending_values: A value with status null and decision pending is present but not mapped. The contract allows unlabelled only when raw_value is null, so its records are quarantined until the team decides (proposed; open question for C3, the alternative is a contract change).
rules.attack_type_values: Values of an attack-type column are kept as EventLabel.attack_type, never mapped to a status.
rules.counts: Profiled record counts from c2-profiling/out/profile.json (not committed); null where the source is not profiled yet.
